risks.quote: AI can sometimes produce information that seems believable but is actually incorrect. Even the references it generates might be fake or wrongly interpreted.
AI can generate content from text or images without the original creator’s consent, raising ethical issues about creativity and authorship.
AI tools may reflect biases present in the data they were trained on, and they often don’t rely on impartial or peer-reviewed sources.
Information you provide to an AI tool might be stored and used by others, so avoid sharing personal or sensitive details with AI.

responsibilities.quote: Always double-check and critically review any factual information produced by AI.
